question_stem: A van of mass $4500\text{ kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $350\text{ kg}$ along a straight horizontal road. The van and trailer are connected by a light rigid tow-bar which is parallel to the road. There are resistance forces of $X\text{ N}$ on the van and $120\text{ N}$ on the trailer. The driving force produced by the van's engine is $2500\text{ N}$. The tension in the tow-bar is $T\text{ N}$, and the acceleration of the van is $0.4\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.question_text: Find the value of $X$ and the value of $T$.
